## B-346-3 — a submit during intent hydration publishes captured defaults, not the package now displayed

**Where:** `src/components/coach/setup/FirstPackageForm.tsx:174-184,191-218,234-241,419-422`; submit validates and captures title/price/billing before awaiting hydration, while hydration changes those displayed fields and installs the remembered package. The button is disabled only by `busy`, not hydration. [Exact form](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/2baea5b82a2d0e0a22bac21e8fdb5e074bec9d60/src/components/coach/setup/FirstPackageForm.tsx).

**Executed counterexample:** persist a known package named “Saved one-time plan”, $99 once; hold the mount's intent read; the enabled form displays defaults “Synthetic coaching”, $49 monthly. Press Create, then release the read. The form now displays the saved $99 one-time plan, but the continuation sends an update for the captured $49 monthly defaults, publishes `pkg_saved`, and calls `onCreated` with those defaults. This can silently convert a resumed one-time offer into a subscription without the coach choosing that edit after seeing the resumed offer. [Independent actual-form/helper execution](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229996072).

The probe runs the actual form/helper over API/storage doubles; the failure is the mismatch between hydrated fields and update/completion, not a live charge or native-device acceptance claim. [Executed lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229996072).

**Minimal fix rule:** do not admit edits or submit while the current account's durable-intent hydration is unresolved. Establish explicit current-generation hydration readiness; if a persisted intent appears, display it and require a fresh user action before updating/publishing. Capture and validate only that ready form snapshot; retain unreadable-storage fail-closed copy and account/retirement fences.

**Verify:** add the held-read saved one-time and free-package cases; early tap must send no update/publish from defaults, and after hydration a deliberate fresh submit must publish exactly the displayed title/price/billing. Replay durability/idempotency and account/unmount controls. Saved audit probe: `ops/aud-119/AUD-SOL-W12-119/346-lifecycle-hydration.test.tsx`. [Failing-before proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229996072).

## Follow-ups (C) — ticket, do not broaden this frozen round

- **C-346-1 (retained optional copy):** `src/components/coach/setup/InviteShareCard.tsx:79-80` still generates “Join my coaching…” boilerplate. Recommended fix: neutral share template while preserving the coach-controlled package name; keeping explicit coach voice is an operator copy decision, not a material correctness blocker. [Share template](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/2baea5b82a2d0e0a22bac21e8fdb5e074bec9d60/src/components/coach/setup/InviteShareCard.tsx).
- **C-346-4 (prior optional async-guard remainder):** `CoachSetupChecklist.tsx:140-158` and `InviteShareCard.tsx:61-96` apply awaited reads/share/copy callbacks without per-operation owner/mount/generation guards. A slower earlier focus-load can replace a newer snapshot; share/clipboard completions can mark the old hint/call the old callback after retirement. Fix rule: capture owner+mount+operation generation, recheck after awaits, and discard superseded loads; add held-load/share/copy controls. Cross-account navigator teardown bounds display impact, so this remains a C, not a duplicate of repaired Connect B-346-2. [Checklist](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/2baea5b82a2d0e0a22bac21e8fdb5e074bec9d60/src/components/coach/setup/CoachSetupChecklist.tsx); [Invite card](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/2baea5b82a2d0e0a22bac21e8fdb5e074bec9d60/src/components/coach/setup/InviteShareCard.tsx).
